authorizationChecks: Android engineeringMutation checks session/trusted registration and company gate; API cookie authentication, company, exact origin, CSRF, transport network; service registered repository/idempotency checks
New draft backend independently enforces all session/company/origin/CSRF/device/signature/nonce/private-network gates, finite policy and transactional authority snapshots.
agentModelDependencies: Engineering manager for bounded planning; no model-selected authority
failureAndCancellation: Company switch/stale response rejected; existing idempotency key is reused by engineering UI; creation can start background drive unless deferred internally.

Separate reviewed activation and real trusted Mac execution; existing draft markers deny all legacy execution paths.

inputOutputContracts: Cookie session -> server-derived authenticated identity and CompanyContext
authorizationChecks: Hashed token lookup, expiry/revocation, company membership/lifecycle; company header is selection, not authority
failureAndCancellation: Missing/revoked state denies; Android clears cached authority on revocation and checks selected company on returned data.
auditEvidence: Identity/governance bounded denial audit; exact route composition must be checked
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Real mobile session/revocation and company switching during an engineering run.

authorizationChecks: Ed25519 signature, device ownership/trust, timestamps/expiry, atomic nonce consumption; authenticated owner/company
failureAndCancellation: Repeated signed envelope denied; signature is not permission for repository operations.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: General-objective path is implemented; it is not the engineering-delivery route. Verify each signed mobile mutation against origin/CSRF policy rather than assuming guards from another route.

transitions.transition: Delivery persistence to bounded engineering plan
authorizationChecks: Owner/company/repository scope; active registered command/capability profiles; no self-improvement route bypass
agentModelDependencies: Existing manager planner and canonical AIRouter where selected; finite task/role/round budgets
failureAndCancellation: Clarification blocks; unavailable planner/provider must not fabricate tasks or receipts. Duplicate-create race and crash between objective/delivery persistence need dedicated joined acceptance.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Real signed mobile create with persistent idempotency and no extra run after duplicate/timeout.

transitions.transition: Task plan to scoped specialized assignment
inputOutputContracts: EngineeringTaskSchema -> active company assignment with role/model policy
persistentState: engineering_tasks; company agent assignments; workforce/economics state
authorizationChecks: Registered repository authorizedAgentIds, active assignment and capability profile; resource/attempt/model tier caps
agentModelDependencies: Existing specialized engineering roles; Workforce candidate ranking; canonical provider/model policy
failureAndCancellation: No eligible specialist yields blocker; canceled/expired lease must not continue through a stale assignment.
auditEvidence: WORKFORCE_TASK_SCHEDULED where workforce path used; engineering task events remain separate
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Real delegated work; do not equate candidate ranking with creation of a generic workforce task for every engineering task.

transitions.transition: Engineering task to Agent OS runtime session
persistentState: Agent OS sessions/runtime events and delegation context references
authorizationChecks: Current company assignment, manifest and repository memory scopes; no ad hoc tool grants
agentModelDependencies: Existing manager/specialist agent definitions and bounded context packages
failureAndCancellation: Replacement lease reconciles only older sessions for exact scoped task; isolated failures do not confer success.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Observed Agent OS session lineage linked to actual Mac task results.

inputOutputContracts: EngineeringTaskSchema lease -> EngineeringWorkspaceSchema and finite EngineeringTransportRequestSchema
authorizationChecks: Owner/company/repository/agent intersection; registered locator/profile; protected paths and branch/head checks
failureAndCancellation: Atomic claims and fenced saves reject old generation; preserve dirty/conflicting work and uncertain mutations instead of replay.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Actual Mac worktree creation, crash at mutation boundary and stale lease denial before effect.

transitions.transition: Structured proposal to deterministic approval and signed execution
inputOutputContracts: Bounded structured model proposal -> EngineeringTransportRequestSchema -> ServerExecutionEnvelopeSchema
authorizationChecks: Current repository/task/workspace lease, finite capability, trusted Mac assignment, policy, exact approval digest, recent authentication where required, network and emergency stop
agentModelDependencies: Canonical AIRouter; model may propose only registered operations
failureAndCancellation: Provider failure denies work; signal cancels queued execution; timeout is not success; no arbitrary command fallback.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Exact signed Android intent -> actual policy/approval -> Mac envelope linkage.

transitions.transition: Signed API execution poll to trusted Mac verification
inputOutputContracts: Signed poll -> ServerExecutionEnvelopeSchema -> finite dispatcher request
persistentState: execution_requests; nonces; heartbeat/cancellation state; Mac result outbox
authorizationChecks: Pinned server key, envelope digest/time/expiry/device, trusted device, current scope and stop checks
failureAndCancellation: Stop/suspend after poll must not start privileged work; cancellations arrive through existing signed poll; disconnect becomes heartbeat expiry, not fallback execution.
auditEvidence: EXECUTION lifecycle audit and signed device result events
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Actual enrolled Mac and Android; Linux fixture is not device acceptance.

transitions.transition: Finite Mac capability to isolated filesystem/Git result
persistentState: Task worktree + persisted operation/workspace metadata and signed result outbox
authorizationChecks: Registered local root; normalized relative paths, blocked/symlink/expected-hash checks; task/lease/capability fencing; finite Git operation
failureAndCancellation: Preserve conflict/dirty state; quarantine approved deletes; reject unknown operations; cancellation suppresses continuation.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Actual Mac effect/receipt under revoke/cancel; no claim of sandbox containment merely from finite operations.

transitions.transition: Task result to registered validation receipts
inputOutputContracts: EngineeringCommandProfileSchema -> EngineeringValidationReportSchema with per-step command/result IDs
authorizationChecks: Immutable registered profile, fixed executable/args/time/resource/network policy; governed approval/lease/stop; shell false and minimal environment
failureAndCancellation: Failure blocks dependent tasks; changed files invalidate receipts; cancellation terminates bounded work; missing checks cannot become PASS.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Real reviewed local validation image/toolchain and Mac-signed lint/typecheck/test/build receipts.

transitions.transition: Validated tasks to integration candidate and independent review
authorizationChecks: Eligible completed task evidence; current candidate head; repository-authorized separate reviewer; lease and scope; no author self-approval
agentModelDependencies: Existing independent reviewer selection and canonical router; model review is advisory evidence, not approval authority
failureAndCancellation: Conflict/stale head blocks; bounded repair has lineage; unavailable reviewer/provider cannot fabricate PASS.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Real separate reviewer and candidate/evidence binding across restart and Mac execution.

transitions.transition: Owner decision to guarded local integration
inputOutputContracts: MergeEngineeringCandidateRequestSchema -> exact approved local merge result
persistentState: approval/decision, candidate status/head and execution result
authorizationChecks: Exact candidate/head/digest, owner/company, recent authentication where required, current validation/review, network/device and stop
failureAndCancellation: Reject preserves candidate; changed base/head invalidates earlier approval; uncertain native result reconciles rather than blind merge retry.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Actual Mac local merge with genuine owner approval and stale/replayed decision rejection. Git push/deploy excluded.

transitions.transition: Engineering evidence to persisted terminal status and notification
authorizationChecks: Owner/company read scope; no new authority from terminal summary or notification
failureAndCancellation: Provider push can be unavailable; canonical API status remains source; delivery DONE is candidate readiness, not proof of deployment or local merge.
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Phone receives correct terminal evidence, including warnings; FCM disabled/default provider is not live delivery proof.

transitions.transition: Canonical status to foreground Android UX / owner controls
inputOutputContracts: EngineeringSnapshot / EngineeringBuild / approval details -> bounded UI state and explicit actions
persistentState: Company-scoped encrypted/cache state; canonical backend records remain authoritative
authorizationChecks: Session/trusted registration, company gate/stale response check, owner-triggered controls; biometric step-up for required approvals
failureAndCancellation: Foreground bounded reconnect; background stops polling; lock/revocation clears authority-sensitive state; no mobile executor.
auditEvidence: Server-side control audit; UI state itself grants nothing
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Real Android lifecycle, request signing, approval/reject/cancel/revise UX, and notification deep-link acceptance.

transitions.transition: Owner cancel/worker failure to fenced recovery
persistentState: Lease generations, objective/task versions, execution cancel/outcome, preserved worktree/diff
authorizationChecks: Current owner/company and authorization; no use of expired lease, revoked device, previous approval or stale candidate
failureAndCancellation: Abort active controllers; persist cancel; deliver poll cancellation; expired work becomes blocked/reviewable. Existing waits/cancel paths need joined race acceptance before claiming no post-cancel effect.
auditEvidence: WORKFORCE_TASK_CANCELLED where workforce path used; ENGINEERING_INTEGRATION_CANCELLED; execution cancel and engineering event records
missingAcceptanceEvidence: Cut network/kill API or worker/revoke device at each real Mac effect boundary; retain unknown outcome and prove no subsequent effect.
